decisionBox.changed: The whole character of the tape flipped between the endday snapshot and this read, and the flip is in the positioning data rather than in the price. Price is only 523.5 points lower - 80,141.4 to 79,617.9, a 0.65 percent drift - but open interest is UP 1.41 percent over the same window, from 2,085,556,502 USD to 2,115,031,593 USD, the OKX 1H long/short account ratio has climbed from 1.06 to 1.11, and funding has flipped from fractionally negative to a small positive 0.00388 percent. Falling price with rising open interest and a rising account ratio is longs ADDING into weakness, which is the exact opposite of the condition that made the 06 September adds work: those were taken after open interest FELL and the ratio dropped. On top of that, 234,267 USD of the 281,094 USD of liquidations in the last three hours were LONG, concentrated at 79,750 and 79,500 - the crowd has already been punished once at these prices and has re-loaded anyway. Endday held position TAKE_PROFIT and trimmed 12 percent of the core at 80,141.4 to rebuild cash for exactly this. That cash now gets partly spent, but only partly: the drift down is what endday wanted to buy, while the leverage rebuild is what argues for keeping half the powder dry.

liquidation.note: 118,457 USD across 50 fills, of which 117,922 USD - 99.5 percent - was LONG. It sits 132.1 points ABOVE spot, which is the uncomfortable part: the forced sellers were liquidated on the way down through this band and price has not reclaimed it. Magnet stays TRUE because it marks the densest concentration of dead leverage on the chart, but it is now overhead supply rather than a target.

96,406 USD across 30 fills, 100 percent LONG, not one short fill in the bucket. This is the second wave of the same flush and it is the pocket that also produced 653,398 USD of long fills at midday on 06 September and 869,402 USD on 05 September. Three separate cohorts of leveraged longs have now died in the 79,500 band inside three days. It is 117.9 points below spot and it is the reason the reduce gate sits at 79,395.0 rather than at the round number - a fourth visit that settles THROUGH the pocket rather than wicking it would be new information.

29,827 USD across 11 fills, 100 percent SHORT. Residue from the 02:00 UTC push to 80,427.6. It is small - a quarter of the size of the 79,750 long cluster - which tells you the short side is not crowded up there any more after last night's 813,202 USD squeeze emptied the 80,500 bucket.
19,939 USD across only 3 fills, all LONG. Thin, and notable mainly because long liquidations printing ABOVE the round number means some leverage was carried in from far higher and cut on the retest.

16,465 USD across 6 fills, 100 percent SHORT - the tail end of the 80,555.4 squeeze that dominated the endday report. Twenty-four hours ago this bucket held 813,202 USD. It is now effectively empty, which is why there is no upside magnet worth trading toward.

calibration.rollingRecord: Settled-close gates: 25 correct out of the last 26 evaluated sessions, with both of endday's gates resolved this run. The 80,685.0 add gate correctly REFUSED - the highest settled hourly close since the 00:44 UTC snapshot was 80,159.1 and the session high only 80,427.6, 257.4 points short. The 79,875.0 reduce gate FIRED, on the 03:00 UTC hourly close of 79,594.8, 280.2 points through the trigger. I am scoring that fire CORRECT but SHALLOW: price is now 79,617.9, so the direction was right and the level has held as resistance, but the follow-through was thin - the lowest low since the fire is 79,541.6, only 53.2 points deeper, and price closed back above the trigger within two hours. That is the second genuine trigger in three days and the second time this week that a correct gate produced a smaller move than the level implied.
calibration.note: Acting HELPED, and for a reason worth separating from the gate. Endday did not act on its own reduce level - it trimmed 12 percent of the spot core at 80,141.4 hours BEFORE the gate armed, on the argument that the 80,555.4 high had been produced by 813,202 USD of forced short covering whose fuel was spent. Spot now marks 79,617.9. That trim banked 523.5 points per coin against where the same units would be valued now, plus a 20 percent sweep to savings, and it is the reason this session has 27.72 USDT to deploy instead of 3.88. The lesson generalises: reading WHY a move happened beat waiting for a level to confirm that it was over. The gate, when it did arm, was 280 points later and only 53 points better.
